trust_decision.summary: Whether a user who may read but not configure an item/agent may receive stored config XML with secret values intact: each of the three history actions decides this in getFile()/getLines() by gating on hasConfigurePermission() and then returning XmlFile.asString() or the side-by-side diff with no masking.

landing_point.why: It is the job route that returns the whole stored config.xml as one String; a reader of 'doesn't redact encrypted values of secrets' greps for asString() and lands here first, with the diff route (line 424) right behind it.

fix_sites.entry_point: shared helper getStringFromXmlFile(XmlFile,boolean) plus getLines(XmlFile,XmlFile,boolean,boolean) used by every showDiffFiles/configOutput view
fix_sites.module_kind: shared abstract action base (library helper, not an HTTP route itself)
HTTP action, root scope (system configs and deleted jobs)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Agent configuration history is already gated by Computer.CONFIGURE (both routes call checkConfigurePermission() first, ComputerConfigHistoryAction.java:117-119), so no read-only user can reach it; the fix's own redaction flag there can only ever be false and getLines(..., false) therefore reads as intentional.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Restore must write back the ORIGINAL secret values: doRestore feeds the same history XmlFile into the live item (updateByXml, XStream.fromXML, createProjectFromXML). A fix that redacts in the shared read path (getOldConfigXml, FileHistoryDao.getOldRevision) or mutates the XmlFile/Line cache would restore '********' over live secrets and corrupt the job, agent or restored deleted job; masking must also not change diff line counts or the side-by-side numbering.

O6_input_shapes: one stored revision read as raw text (XmlFile.asString) vs two revisions' XSLT-sorted text diffed into SideBySideView lines
encrypted Secret values (serialized as {AQAA...}) vs clear-text <authToken> values (the fix adds its own authToken regex only on the diff route; see unverified for why that regex looks mismatched)
the same file served through the same getFile() as type=xml and type=raw (base getOutputType, JobConfigHistoryBaseAction.java:116-121)
a null XmlFile, which the new helper maps to an empty string rather than dereferencing it

O8_uncovered_routes.route: root configOutput for a deleted job returns the stored revision raw: xmlFile.asString() with no redaction, behind exactly the same guard as the root diff route the fix redacted ((name contains _deleted_ && hasJobConfigurePermission()) || hasConfigurePermission())
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: That branch already demands global Item.CONFIGURE (hasJobConfigurePermission), a stronger permission than the ExtendedRead the advisory is about, so the user is trusted with job configuration and can restore or re-create the job anyway; no masking is needed here.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the fixed root getLines, 2 methods apart, 0 packages

O8_uncovered_routes.route: agent showDiffFiles never redacts: the fix hardcodes getLines(..., false) while redacting getFile() next to it, so the agent diff route into the same sink carries no protection at all
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Computer.CONFIGURE is required before getLines() runs, so the diff view is administrator-only and the advisory's read-only scenario cannot arise for agents.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: second action class, 1 file from the job landing point, same package

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a base-level redaction applied to Line/List<Line> output (instead of only to String) so that the project, root and agent diff views share one masking path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the fix already duplicates masking in two shapes (String helper plus JobConfigHistoryProjectAction.redactAuthTokensInLines); a maintainer tidying that duplication into the base is the obvious next commit and would silently change all three diff views.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: redaction at the lower-level public API getOldRevision(...) that every route and the restore path read through
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: one change there covers all six read routes, which is exactly the tempting single-point fix; it also silently corrupts doRestore, so the sibling forces the solver to understand the producer/consumer split.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a configOutput route that threads the same redactSecrets flag the fix added to getLines, with a deleted-job and a system-config branch
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the root action already computes a redactSecrets flag for one of two adjacent views on the same page and under the same guard, so a maintainer fixing this area would naturally have written the second one too.

O9_family: CWE-312 sensitive-information exposure: stored job/agent configuration revisions returned without redacting secret values (also CWE-200 family)

O10_build.toolchain: Maven with org.jenkins-ci.plugins:plugin:5.28 parent, jenkins.version 2.504.3 (JDK 17+ baseline); single module hpi
O10_build.project_tests: JUnit 5 + JenkinsRule: JobConfigHistoryProjectActionTest (testGetFile, testGetLines), JobConfigHistoryRootActionTest, JobConfigHistoryBaseActionTest (with a JobConfigHistoryBaseActionImpl subclass, line 198), ComputerConfigHistoryActionIT, GetDiffLinesTest, FileHistoryDaoTest; failsafe excludes JobConfigHistoryProjectActionIT, JobConfigHistoryRootActionIT, JobConfigBadgeActionIT and PluginIT (pom.xml:132-138), and the fix adds its permission/redaction IT cases to the excluded JobConfigHistoryProjectActionIT.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap only JobConfigHistoryProjectAction.getFile()'s xmlFile.asString() in ExtendedReadRedaction.applyAll (or mask <authToken> once in the one diff view the report shows), leaving the diff routes, the root configOutput route, the agent action and the plaintext/encrypted shape split alone.

out_of_scope_notes: src/main/resources/hudson/plugins/jobConfigHistory/JobConfigHistoryRootAction/showDiffFiles.jelly:60,73 links to it.getProject().getUrl(), but JobConfigHistoryRootAction defines no getProject() (it is a RootAction); an unrelated pre-existing UI defect, noted once and not pursued.
unverified: repo_mb could not be measured (no shell); 45 main Java files and 223 files in total put the source well under 5 MB, which is the basis for tiny_repo.
jenkins.security.ExtendedReadRedaction is assumed present in jenkins-core 2.504.3 because the fix imports it without touching pom.xml; the jar could not be inspected in this sandbox.

Static reading suggests JobConfigHistoryProjectAction.AUTH_TOKEN_REGEX ('<authToken>.*?</authToken>', escaped entities, 8 stars) cannot match SideBySideView.Line text, which GetDiffLines.java:174-207 sets to the raw diff row text ('<authToken>'), while the fix's own tests assert the 6-star core mask; not verified by running tests, and the IT that asserts it is excluded from failsafe.

Whether Item.CONFIGURE implies Item.EXTENDED_READ in the core ACL was not verified; it decides whether the root configOutput route is reachable by exactly the user set for which the fix redacts the root diff route.
present_in_latest is unknown for both O8 routes because no latest release was provided.
